newsitem.title: USA: Anicom acquires Connectivity Tech unit.
newsitem.headline: Anicom acquires Connectivity Tech unit.

text.p: Anicom Inc said Monday it acquired Connectivity Technologies Inc's Energy Electric Technologies Inc unit for $10 million in cash and $2 million in stock.

Under the deal, Anicom also paid down $17 million of debt held by Connectivity Products Inc, which also is a unit of Connectivity Technologies. In addition Anicom also entered a supply agreement with Connectivity Products.
Energy Electric, based in Auburn Hills, Mich., sells and distributes multimedia wiring products and had about $61 million in net sales in fiscal year 1996.
The acquisition was Anicom's tenth since July 1995.
"A hallmark of Anicom is our ability to acquire companies that are accretive and consolidate them rapidly to maximize operating leverage and profitability," said Chairman Alan Anixter.
